messages:
ana_support: Hey @josh_eng @lee_runtime — urgent customer escalation. ACME integration started returning tool errors after we pushed a small system-prompt tweak yesterday. They see schema validation failures and occasional 500s. Repro below, logs attached in-line.

josh_eng: copying. can you paste the minimal repro (curl + payload)? also which model & runtime?

ana_support: (typo) ana_support: model: redwood/gptx-3b-v1, runtime: hosted-default. Root request ts 2026-02-21T14:03:32Z (thread ts).

ana_support: Repro steps:
1) call /v1/chat/completions with system prompt that includes a few example tool calls (see below)
2) user asks to 'charge' an invoice
3) model returns a function call whose args are mostly strings and include dollar signs/commas, which the payment tool rejects with schema error.

ana_support: example request body we sent:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood/gptx-3b-v1",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are a payments assistant. Example tool call:
{\"name\":\"charge\",\"arguments\":{\"amount\":\"$12.00\",\"currency\":\"USD\",\"payer_id\":\"user_123\"}}
Always produce valid JSON for tools."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Charge invoice inv_987 for 12 dollars"}
  ],
  "functions": [
    {"name":"charge","parameters": {"type":"object","properties": {"amount": {"type":"number"}, "currency": {"type":"string"}, "payer_id": {"type":"string"}}, "required":["amount","currency","payer_id"]}}
  ],
  "function_call": "auto"
}
```

ana_support: Observed model function call (what we got back):
```
{"name":"charge","arguments":{"amount":"$12.00","currency":"USD","payer_id":"user_123"}}
```

ana_support: Upstream payment tool enforces amount as number (cents float). Tool returned: 400 Bad Request / schema validation failed: field 'amount' expected number, got string. Sometimes downstream we got 500 internal when sanitization code crashed trying to parse leading '$'. Billing team also noticed a small usage spike from retries ~+17% last night.

lee_runtime: hmm, system prompt includes a few-shot example that uses quotes around amount and a $ sign. Model probably learned format from example. This is classic example shadowing / format bleed.

priya_ml: agree. the system example explicitly shows amount as string with currency symbol. That will bias generation. Also note functions schema expects number and our kernel-level validation returns 400 before tool runs. We need to prevent model from emitting $/string for numeric fields.

sam_ops: Customer reports auth errors intermittently too: some requests returned 401 for the tool endpoint. Logs show X-Request-Id 8a7f... correlating with retries. Could be our retry/backoff hitting a locked credential state when validation fails.

ana_support: customer sent their sanitized logs: 
```
ERROR payment-service 2026-02-21T14:04:12Z request=8a7f... status=400 msg=\"schema validation failed\" details=\"amount: expected number got string
\"
ERROR gateway 2026-02-21T14:04:13Z request=8a7f... status=401 msg=\"invalid auth token\"
```

josh_eng: can eng-runtime reproduce locally? @lee_runtime can you run the same chat request against hosted-default w/ model pinned and capture raw function_call payload? include model version hash.

lee_runtime: running now, taking a snapshot. also will test with system prompt removed and with examples reformatted (numbers without $ and unquoted).

priya_ml: suggested mitigations:
- immediate: add a webhook sanitizer in the tool-wrapper to coerce numeric strings to numbers (strip $/, remove commas) and fail loudly if ambiguous. This reduces customer impact quickly.
- medium: update our recommended examples in system prompts and template docs to use unquoted numeric literals for numeric parameters and explicit notes: \"function arguments must match function schema types\".
- long-term: add automated lint that flags system/few-shot examples that show schema mismatches for registered functions. Could hook into Redwood Console CI.

sam_ops: I'll open a short-live patch on the payment-tool wrapper to coerce amounts. Will also add a circuit breaker on too-many-retries to avoid auth lockouts.

ana_support: customer asked for a timeline and repro steps included for them. They asked we do not change model behavior without coordination. Proposed comms: \"we will deploy a non-invasive wrapper that sanitizes amounts and will follow up with guidance on updating prompts/examples.\"

josh_eng: plan from eng: (1) hotfix wrapper sanitizer -> ship within 2 hours, (2) runtime test matrix to verify function_call output with/without system example -> run in staging today, (3) docs + console lint -> schedule next sprint. @priya_ml can you own the lint design?

priya_ml: yes, I'll draft rules: detect quoted numerics, currency symbols in examples for any function parameter typed as number. Also include unit tests to catch new examples.

lee_runtime: result of quick run: with original system prompt we do get quoted \"$12.00\" in function_call. when I remove the example or change example to amount: 12.00 (no quotes) the function_call emits a numeric 12.0. I'll attach the raw diffs in the incident ticket.

ops_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4321. Severity: High (customer facing, billing impact). Assignees: sam_ops, josh_eng, priya_ml, lee_runtime.

ana_support: customer ok with wrapper approach, please update here when hotfix deployed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

josh_eng: will post deploy status. updating thread.

lee_runtime: hotfix deployed to payment-wrapper canary 14:38Z. sanitizer strips ^\u0024 and commas and casts to float. Observed immediate 0 failures on canary tests. Rolling to 50% now.

sam_ops: rolling to 100% 14:46Z. auth 401s stopped. retry storm subsided. billing spike leveling off.

ana_support: relaying to customer: hotfix deployed, monitoring. they replied \"thanks, that fixed it for now\".

priya_ml: follow-ups: PR for lint rules opened -> link: https://git.redwood/repo/prompt-lint/pulls/12 (internal). Also we'll update the prompt templates in onboarding docs and propose a console warning when function schemas mismatch example types.

josh_eng: great work team. we'll keep the thread and close once docs PR merges and lint is live.
